content_sections.heading: How-to-Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for UBKV Project Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the name of the post announced by UBKV?
faq.answer: Uttar Banga Krishi Viswavidyalaya has announced vacancies for the Project Fellow post under the research field through their latest recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UBKV Project Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Fellow position in this recruitment drive conducted by Uttar Banga Krishi Viswavidyalaya.

faq.question: Q3. What is the date for the UBKV Project Fellow walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Fellow position at Uttar Banga Krishi Viswavidyalaya is scheduled to be held on 08-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Agriculture with a minimum of six months of work experience in Bio-efficacy and phyto-toxicity of herbicides and computer knowledge.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the UBKV Project Fellow position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Fellow post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 25,000/- as per the official recruitment guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for UBKV Project Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be below 35 years of age as on 1st August, 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST candidates up to 5 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application and selection for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in, and candidates will be selected directly through a walk-in interview process conducted by Uttar Banga Krishi Viswavidyalaya.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for UBKV Project Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification released by Uttar Banga Krishi Viswavidyalaya for the Project Fellow recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Uttar Banga Krishi Viswavidyalaya located?
faq.answer: Uttar Banga Krishi Viswavidyalaya is located in Cooch Behar, West Bengal, with the pincode 736165, which is also the primary operational area for the university.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I bring for the UBKV walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring two copies of applications, detailed bio-data, two sets of photocopies of all educational documents from Madhyamik onwards, passport-size photos, and category proofs.
